title: P02 4.4 ADC 建立值的二阶闭式重算

model.name: two_node_rc_closed_form
model.description: Source Vs -- Rs -- node A -- Rw -- node B; Cext from A to ground; Csample from B to ground; both capacitors start at zero; ideal full-scale step; constant R and C.
assumptions: Both capacitors have zero initial voltage; this is not a MUX precharge or channel-switch state.
The source is an ideal full-scale step with zero output impedance beyond Rs.
No switch charge injection, leakage, dielectric absorption or noise.
The reported residual is a settling-model result, not total ADC accuracy.

canonicalization.method: payload={"model": model, "recompute_cases": recompute_cases}; json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'); SHA-256

single_pole_proxy.name: single_pole_tau_proxy
single_pole_proxy.note: Screening proxy only; it is not the two-node residual and must not be quoted as a pointwise bound.

p02_claims.note: P02 table prints Rs=1100 ohm and tau=210 us; with Rw=1000 ohm, Cext=100 nF, Cs=5 pF, t=10 us this reproduces 3905.5 LSB on a 4096-code scale.
P02 table prints Rs=110 ohm and Cext=1 nF; with Rw=1000 ohm, Cs=5 pF, t=10 us the single-pole proxy gives 0.5239 LSB.

difference.cause: The two-node slow mode is dominated by Rs*Cext (about 110 us), not by the single-pole (Rs+Rw)*(Cext+Cs) proxy (about 210 us).

recompute_cases.decision_basis: 3740 LSB is far above 0.5 LSB; the buffer-required conclusion is unchanged, but the quoted number must be the two-node 3740 LSB, not 3905 LSB.

difference.cause: The two-node slow rate is about 9.04e6 1/s (tau about 0.111 us); 10 us is about 90 slow time constants, so the single-pole 0.524 LSB is a proxy artifact.

recompute_cases.decision_basis: The 0.524 LSB marginal-fail claim is refuted as a single-pole proxy result. The two-node model passes, but actual ADC Csh/Rsw, charge injection and MUX state are not modeled; keep 470 pF as the conservative selection and verify on bench.

difference.cause: The two-node slow rate is about 1.99e7 1/s (tau about 50 ns), about 10.5x faster than the single-pole proxy tau of 0.527 us; the proxy overstates the residual at short t_ACQ.

recompute_cases.decision_basis: The single-pole proxy gives 92.25 LSB at 2 us, but the two-node model gives 1.12e-13 LSB; the proxy is not a pointwise bound. Keep the level for the bench experiment only; no adopt.

difference.cause: The two-node slow rate is about 1.99e7 1/s (tau about 50 ns); 5 us is about 99 slow time constants, so the single-pole 0.312 LSB is a proxy artifact.

recompute_cases.decision_basis: The two-node model passes at 5 us, but actual ADC Csh/Rsw, charge injection and MUX state are not modeled; keep 470 pF and verify on bench.

difference.cause: The two-node slow rate is about 1.99e7 1/s (tau about 50 ns); 10 us is about 198 slow time constants, so the single-pole 2.37e-5 LSB is a proxy artifact.

recompute_cases.decision_basis: The 10 us working point passes in the two-node model but remains conditional until bench data; keep 470 pF.

independent_check.note: Independent numerical integration in the test must agree with the closed form; it is not a hardware measurement.

not_checked: Actual ADC Csh and Rsw; the values 5 pF and 1000 ohm are model assumptions.
MUX channel-to-channel charge sharing and channel sequence.
Switch charge injection, input leakage, dielectric absorption and noise.
Bench step response, temperature sweep and batch consistency.
Total ADC accuracy, INL/DNL, reference droop and calibration uncertainty.
The 470 pF cases are model predictions; they are not bench evidence for 2/5/10 us.
